messages:
ana (finance): Hey team — Harbor Tech still hasn't cleared INV-2026-342 ($42,600) due 2026-03-08. AP told us earlier they'd push a wire but no confirmation yet. Can someone ping the AE / ops contact? We need a firm ETA before Friday or we'll start the billing-hold procedure.

mike (acct-exec): pinged J. Lee at accounts-payable@harbortech.com ~10m ago. They said they need PO# HT-9987 to match remittance. I just emailed PO and asked for proof of wire. Will update when I hear back.

jlee (Harbor Tech): Sorry for the lag — CFO was OOO. We have approval now. Wire scheduled for 2026-03-11 morning, remit will include INV-2026-342 and PO HT-9987. ETA: EOD 2026-03-11. If we do a partial payment now, can that avoid the hold? :pray:

ana (finance): Partial payment is okay as a temporary measure. We need at least 50% ($21,300) posted before 2026-03-12 09:00 UTC to prevent the account suspension. If you can provide same-day proof of payment (screenshot or remittance file) we'll delay the hold. Please ensure remittance references the invoice number.

mike (acct-exec): I offered a one-time courtesy credit of $1,200 to cover the activity spike if they send full wire by EOD 3/11. Harbor asked for that in writing. @jlee can you confirm you'll accept the credit and wire timeline? :thumbsup:

jlee (Harbor Tech): Confirmed — we accept the $1,200 credit if you email confirmation. We'll aim for full wire on the morning of 3/11 and send remittance immediately after.

katie (legal): Quick note: our escalation policy is to issue a demand letter if PTP (promise to pay) is missed and no funds arrive within 7 calendar days from the promised date. If wire misses 3/11 and no PTP, we plan a demand letter around 3/18–3/20. Prefer to keep this off the calendar. Also confirm whether late fees per SOW should apply before escalation.

sara (support): FYI ops flagged a small degraded job due to token caps yesterday; if a billing hold happens some scheduled jobs will be paused. I can queue re-enable work as soon as payment clears.

collections-bot: Reminder: Billing hold scheduled for account "harbor-tech" on 2026-03-12 09:00 UTC if outstanding balance > $0. Run `/payments check INV-2026-342` to pull latest status.

ana (finance): Thanks. @mike once you get remittance screenshot (mask acct numbers) paste it here and I'll clear the hold. I'll also send the $1,200 credit confirmation to J. Lee by email and cc this thread.

mike (acct-exec): Will do. sent wire instructions (masked) to AP earlier: ```
Account: ****-1234
Ref: INV-2026-342 / HT-9987
Amount: $42,600
```

jlee (Harbor Tech): Received. Wire scheduled 03/11 09:30 PST. I'll post remittance here when the bank confirms. Thanks everyone.

ana (finance): Great — leaving this open until we see remittance. If anything changes, update here. :v:
